pages.text: The $(item)Trade Post$() is a steel trading desk two blocks wide and two high that admins place at spawn and in hubs. It is where players trade with each other, and where the $(l:coins/market)market$() is.$(br2)Its four keys open their pages: $(l)MARKET$(), $(l)SELL$(), $(l)COLLECT$() and $(l)TRADE$(). Click anywhere else on the desk for the market.

pages.name: Trade Post
pages.text: The Exchange Desk. The scales on the counter tip while a trade runs, and the beacons on the hood turn while anyone uses the post.

At the right of the screen is everyone standing at a Trade Post on any server of the network, with their server's name. A grey mark means they are busy in a trade.$(br2)Pick a name and press $(l)TRADE$() to ask them. See $(l:coins/trading)Trading with Players$().
